description: Camera teleoperation for the Aero Hand: track Jake's hand from a camera and map his finger positions onto the hand in real time. First look for something already built (Chestnut/TetherIA aero-hand-open repo, its GUI or examples, MediaPipe/dex-retargeting style retargeting) before writing new code. LEFT hand; SDK in third_party/aero_hand/upstream/sdk.

user_request.name: quickly translating camera finger positions into positions on the thing basically like teleoperating... map my hand positions to the actual hand... maybe they already have this built in

summary: Jake wants camera-based teleoperation that tracks his left hand and mirrors his finger positions onto the Aero Hand in real time. Check for existing solutions first, such as the aero-hand-open repo, its GUI and examples, or MediaPipe and dex-retargeting, before writing new code.
